tagline: A megacity of 32 million on a sinking coast — Dutch colonial squares, giant malls, and the street food of 17,000 islands in one bowl.
overview: Jakarta is Southeast Asia's biggest urban sprawl — the wider metro holds around 32 million people, making it one of the largest urban areas on earth. It's chaotic, hot and gridlocked — and Indonesia's beating heart of culture and money.

The past survives at Kota Tua, the old Dutch East Indies quarter of faded colonial facades around Fatahillah Square, while the National Monument's gold-flame obelisk towers over Merdeka Square. Sunda Kelapa port still takes wooden phinisi schooners as it has for 500 years.

Speed's 2024 Southeast Asia tour streamed from Jakarta to enormous crowds — Indonesia is one of his biggest fanbases. The city's hidden gift is food: warteg rice stalls and padang feasts gather the cuisine of an archipelago of 17,000 islands.

funFacts.title: ONE OF EARTH'S BIGGEST
funFacts.text: Greater Jakarta holds ~32 million — among the world's largest urban areas.

funFacts.title: A SINKING CAPITAL
funFacts.text: The city sinks up to 25cm a year in places — Indonesia is moving the capital to Nusantara.

funFacts.title: 17,000 ISLANDS ON A PLATE
funFacts.text: Padang, Javanese, Betawi and more — the city tastes like the whole archipelago.

funFacts.title: KOTA TUA
funFacts.text: The old Dutch quarter's facades and Fatahillah Square recall Batavia's colonial era.

funFacts.title: MONAS
funFacts.text: The National Monument's gold-flame top rises 132m over Merdeka Square.

funFacts.title: SAILING PORT
funFacts.text: Sunda Kelapa's wooden phinisi ships have loaded cargo for 500+ years.

funFacts.title: MALL CAPITAL
funFacts.text: Over 170 malls — including some of Asia's largest — define middle-class life.

funFacts.title: THOUSAND ISLANDS
funFacts.text: Pulau Seribu's reef islands sit an hour offshore — the city's beach escape.

funFacts.title: BETAWI CULTURE
funFacts.text: The native Betawi culture blends Malay, Chinese, Arab and colonial roots.

funFacts.title: CRAZY TRAFFIC
funFacts.text: Motorcycle rivers and legendary jams shape the city's rhythm — and its ojek taxis.
